article.title: 기는 하지만
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL teacher’s guide explains **-기는 하지만** as partially acknowledging a fact before adding a different or contrasting aspect. Its examples include **예쁘기는 하지만 너무 비싸요** and **김치를 담글 수 있기는 하지만 잘 못해요**. The guide also marks a change-of-topic continuation as unsuitable in one example, so this entry limits the construction to same-topic partial concession/contrast with a relevant second aspect.
